ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensure that the format of the CRN is correctly captured by User, and follow the finnish format. This rule can be bypassed by a User by checking the field 'BypassVR' on its account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ER_Company_Account_RT' && ISPICKVAL( ER_BUPicklist__c, 'FI') && NOT(REGEX( ER_Registration_Number__c , "[0-9]{7}-[0-9]{1}"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Company Registration Number must be 9 alphanumeric characters long with the following format: 0000000-0 (7 digits then "-" then 1 digit)
